title: https://hpiers.obspm.fr/iers/bul/bulc/BULLETINC.GUIDE.html
summary: The IERS Bulletin C guide: when leap seconds are announced, how UTC differs from TAI by whole seconds to keep UT1-UTC under 0.9 s, and that only June and December dates have been used since 1972.

assertions.quote: It differs from TAI by an integral number of seconds, in such a way that UT1-UTC stays smaller than 0.9s in absolute value. The decision to introduce a leap second in UTC to meet this condition is the responsability of the IERS.
